import math
from collections import deque


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    s = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        s[i + 1] = s[i] + a[i]

    hull = deque()
    best_p, best_q = s[k], k
    s_local = s

    for j in range(k, n + 1):
        i = j - k
        si = s_local[i]
        while len(hull) >= 2:
            x1 = hull[-2]
            x2 = hull[-1]
            if (s_local[x2] - s_local[x1]) * (i - x2) >= (si - s_local[x2]) * (x2 - x1):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(i)

        sj = s_local[j]
        while len(hull) >= 2:
            x1 = hull[0]
            x2 = hull[1]
            if (sj - s_local[x1]) * (j - x2) <= (sj - s_local[x2]) * (j - x1):
                hull.popleft()
            else:
                break

        x = hull[0]
        p = sj - s_local[x]
        q = j - x
        if p * best_q > best_p * q:
            best_p, best_q = p, q

    g = math.gcd(best_p, best_q)
    return [best_p // g, best_q // g]
